entities.name: Michail Nikolajewitsch de Giers

entities.summary: Mikhail Nikolayevich von Giers (1856–1924) was a Russian diplomat who served as the ambassador to Italy and the Ottoman Empire. He was the son of foreign minister Nikolay Girs.
